component.name: Miryu Software Center
component.summary: A modern RPM package manager powered by dnf5daemon
使用 dnf5daemon 的现代 RPM 软件中心

description.p: Miryu is a modern graphical package manager for RPM-based Linux distributions (Fedora, RHEL, CentOS Stream, openEuler, deepin, etc.). It uses the dnf5daemon-server DBus API for all RPM package operations and provides an external launcher for the Linglong Store. It is built with Qt6 and KDE Frameworks 6.
Miryu 是一个用于基于 RPM 的 Linux 发行版（Fedora、RHEL、CentOS Stream、openEuler、deepin 等）的 现代图形软件包管理器。它使用 dnf5daemon-server DBus API 进行所有 RPM 软件包操作， 并提供如意玲珑商店的外部启动入口。 使用 Qt6 和 KDE Frameworks 6 构建。

ul.li: Browse installed, available, and upgradable RPM packages
Search packages by name, summary, or description
Install, update, remove, downgrade, and reinstall RPM packages
Update checking with repository priority filtering
External launcher for the Linglong Store (/usr/bin/linglong-store)

description.p: Remove built-in Linglong store and management pages; replace with external launcher for /usr/bin/linglong-store.
Initial release of Miryu Software Center.
